description: Source code implementing system path retrieval functions for Windows, including executable path, directory, content path, temp path, and application data folder, with platform-specific Windows API calls.

methods.name: GetBinaryName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the current executable module.

methods.name: GetExecutablePath
methods.description: Gets the full path to the current executable.

methods.name: GetExecutableDirectory
methods.description: Gets the directory containing the current executable.

methods.name: GetContentPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the content data directory.

methods.name: CreateAndGetTempPath
methods.description: Creates and retrieves the temporary directory path.

methods.name: CreateAndGetApplicationDataFolder
methods.description: Creates and retrieves the application data folder path.

methods.name: SbSystemGetPath
methods.description: Main function to get various system paths based on path ID.
